+csv.notes: +csv means it is CSV, which is compressible.

+gzip.notes: +gzip means it is a GZIP archive, which is not compressible.

+json.notes: +json means it is JSON, which is compressible.

+json-seq.notes: +json-seq means it is a JSON text sequence, which is compressible.

+xml.notes: +xml means it is XML, which is compressible.

+yaml.notes: +yaml means it is YAML, which is compressible.

+zip.notes: +zip means it is a ZIP archive, which is not compressible.
